threat_event: Coordinated business email compromise campaign takes over agent and closer mailboxes and diverts closing funds with altered wire instructions across several transactions
threat_source: Organized BEC and wire fraud groups
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 38,000 contractor agents on relayable push MFA and own devices; legacy tenants without email security; manual callback on 14% of disbursements; 3 diverted wires in 2026 H1
affected_asset_or_process: BP-05; BP-06; SYS-03; SYS-04; SYS-06; title escrow trust accounts
regulatory_driver: N53-R01 (314.4(c)(5); 314.4(c)(8)); N53-R05 (Form 8-K Item 1.05); Fla. Stat. 626.8473(4) (Florida worked example)
existing_controls: Wire instructions only in the Hub; payee verification on 86% of disbursements; dual approval; security keys for funds staff; DMARC at reject; SOC BEC use cases; funds response desk
treatment_plan: Phishing-resistant MFA and session binding for agents (POAM-001); payee verification to 98% and independent callback numbers (POAM-006); legacy tenant migration (POAM-004); fraud-loss materiality scenario and tabletop (POAM-008)
key_risk_indicator: Diverted-wire attempts and losses per quarter; verification coverage; agent accounts with phishing-resistant MFA

threat_event: Spoofed payoff letter or altered payee bank details redirect a loan payoff or seller proceeds
threat_source: Organized BEC and wire fraud groups
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Payoffs to lenders not on the payoff service rely on manual callback; 4 of 60 sampled callbacks used the number on the payoff letter itself
existing_controls: Payoff aggregation service for about 60% of lenders; amount checks against the settlement statement; dual approval
treatment_plan: Independent-source callback numbers enforced in the Hub; expand verification to non-portal lenders and exchange accommodators (POAM-006)
key_risk_indicator: Share of payoffs verified electronically; callback exceptions found in QA

threat_event: Fraudster impersonates the owner of vacant land or a non-owner-occupied property, sells it, and collects the proceeds
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Address confirmation for these property types is not yet in place; identity checks rely on documents the fraudster can forge
existing_controls: Seller identity verification with document and selfie match; title examiner red flag checklist
treatment_plan: Address confirmation and owner outreach for high-risk property types (POAM-014)
key_risk_indicator: Seller verification failures; red flag referrals

threat_event: Funds are diverted at AQ-09, where wires below $100,000 need one approver and payee accounts are not verified
threat_source: Organized BEC and wire fraud groups
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: AQ-09 legacy closing software and own trust accounts outside the Disbursement Hub
regulatory_driver: N53-R01 (314.4(c)(1)(ii)); Fla. Stat. 626.8473(4) (Florida worked example of the trust fund duty)
existing_controls: Callback procedure; bank positive pay
treatment_plan: Bank-enforced dual approval on all AQ-09 wires by 2026-10-31; migration into SYS-02 and the Disbursement Hub (POAM-005)
key_risk_indicator: AQ-09 wires released without a second approver

threat_event: BEC through the legacy email tenants at AQ-06 to AQ-08 goes undetected because they lack the enterprise email security stack and SIEM feeds
threat_source: Organized BEC and wire fraud groups
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 2,900 agents and 260 employees on tenants with default filtering, no forwarding-rule alerts, and no mailbox audit feed; their agents use SYS-01
affected_asset_or_process: AQ-06 to AQ-08 mailboxes; SYS-01; BP-01
existing_controls: Provider default filtering; quarterly manual rule review by local IT
treatment_plan: SIEM connectors and forwarding-rule alerts (POAM-003); migration to the enterprise tenant (POAM-004)
key_risk_indicator: Legacy mailboxes in SIEM; forwarding rules found

threat_event: A buyer wires an earnest money deposit to a fraudster after an agent's mailbox is compromised
threat_source: Organized BEC and wire fraud groups
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Agents still email deposit instructions in some offices; buyers trust messages from their agent
existing_controls: Deposit instructions only from the Hub or the brokerage escrow page; deposit verification within 10 business days catches missing deposits
treatment_plan: Agent training completion (POAM-015); deposit instruction notice in every contract packet
owner: Florida Broker of Record (with each state's broker of record)
key_risk_indicator: Deposit verification exceptions; buyer fraud reports

threat_event: An insider closer or escrow employee colludes with an outsider to change payee details
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Funds roles see payee data; collusion between two approvers would defeat dual approval
existing_controls: Dual approval in different roles; signed approvals; background checks; daily payee change anomaly report
treatment_plan: Real-time anomaly alerts from AI-009 (SI-4(12)); rotate approver pairings
key_risk_indicator: Payee changes approved by the same pair repeatedly

threat_event: Fraudster spoofs a rental property owner and changes the owner distribution bank account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Owner account changes are handled by property management accounting with callback only
existing_controls: Callback to the number on file; owner portal notice of changes
treatment_plan: Bank account ownership verification for owner distributions
key_risk_indicator: Owner bank account changes per month; failed verifications

threat_event: An exchange accommodator disbursement is diverted through a spoofed instruction
threat_source: Organized BEC and wire fraud groups
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Exchange accommodator disbursements rely on manual callback
existing_controls: Callback procedure; dual approval
treatment_plan: Add exchange accommodators to the verification provider's directory (POAM-006)

threat_event: An emergency change alters a wire-instruction template or approval rule without a second approval
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 3 of 40 sampled emergency changes skipped the second approval; no post-implementation review
existing_controls: Two-reviewer pull requests for normal changes; deployment only through the pipeline
treatment_plan: Pipeline refuses deployment without two recorded approvals (POAM-009)

threat_event: Bank API client secrets are misused to submit payment files outside the Disbursement Hub
threat_source: Malicious insider or attacker with pipeline access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Secrets stored as pipeline variables visible to 46 engineers and not rotated since 2025-02
existing_controls: Mutual TLS also required by the banks; bank-side file limits
treatment_plan: Rotate and vault the secrets; pipeline guardrail against secrets in variables (POAM-010)

threat_event: Departed contractor agents keep access to SYS-01, email, and client files for days after leaving
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Departures reach identity governance only when a managing broker files a notice; 9 of 60 sampled departures kept access more than 7 days
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01; SYS-06; Hub agent view; BP-10
existing_controls: Managing broker notice; monthly reconciliation of active agents
treatment_plan: Daily feed from agent services and state license status into identity governance (POAM-002)
key_risk_indicator: Median hours from departure to disablement

threat_event: Attackers mass-download closing documents (identity documents, bank statements, Social Security numbers) from compromised agent or closer accounts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Agents view closing documents from unmanaged devices; download controls rely on conditional access
existing_controls: Mass download use case in the SIEM; no downloads to unmanaged devices from the Hub
treatment_plan: Download limits in SYS-01; session binding (POAM-001)

threat_event: Ransomware with data theft hits the colocation file servers holding 610,000 legacy scanned closing files
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Unencrypted legacy files under compensating controls; no retention review
existing_controls: Cage access; no remote write access; EDR; SOC monitoring
treatment_plan: Retention review, disposal, and migration of the rest to an encrypted archive (POAM-013)

threat_event: A cloud misconfiguration exposes the Hub document store or the data warehouse
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Many accounts and frequent changes
existing_controls: Preventive guardrails; daily posture scans
treatment_plan: Extend preventive policies to all storage services
key_risk_indicator: Critical posture findings open more than 7 days

threat_event: Attackers take over consumer Hub accounts by credential stuffing or by reading the email one-time code
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Consumer sign-in uses an email one-time code; buyers are not identity-verified
existing_controls: Lockout after 5 failures; instructions cannot be changed by consumers; re-authentication before viewing instructions
treatment_plan: Passkey or verified phone sign-in; buyer identity verification (POAM-014)

threat_event: Tenant screening reports and applicant data kept indefinitely are exposed in a breach
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Screening reports kept indefinitely in SYS-10
existing_controls: Vendor SOC 2 report; role-based access
treatment_plan: Retention rule and purge for screening reports (POAM-013)
key_risk_indicator: Screening reports older than the retention period

threat_event: Relocating employees' household and personal data is exposed through the relocation platform
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SaaS platform with corporate client and employee data
existing_controls: Tier-1 vendor review; SOC 2 Type 2 report reviewed
treatment_plan: SL-2 SOC 2 readiness actions (P09)

threat_event: A closing package is emailed to the wrong recipient
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Some lenders still request documents by email
existing_controls: Data loss prevention blocks closing document attachments from Title and Escrow mailboxes
treatment_plan: Extend data loss prevention rules to brokerage transaction coordinators

threat_event: A company laptop is lost or stolen
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 14,500 company laptops and desktops
existing_controls: Full-disk encryption; remote wipe; EDR
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low with encryption on all company endpoints

threat_event: Infostealer malware on an agent's own device captures session tokens and client documents
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Agents use unmanaged personal devices; sessions are not bound to a device
existing_controls: Browser-only access under conditional access; token replay detection
treatment_plan: Device-bound passkeys and session binding (POAM-001)
owner: Director of Identity and Access Management

threat_event: A workforce member or agent pastes customer data into an unapproved generative AI tool
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Free AI tools are easy to reach from personal devices
existing_controls: Approved enterprise AI assistant; acceptable use policy POL-05
treatment_plan: Unapproved AI domains blocked on company devices and in the browser session for SYS-01; agents use only the approved assistant

threat_event: Unmanaged copies of customer information accumulate in data warehouse extracts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Extracts are easy to create and rarely deleted
existing_controls: Tokenized bank data; access reviews
treatment_plan: Automatic expiry of extracts after 90 days

threat_event: Ransomware encrypts enterprise systems and stops closings and transactions in several states
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Large estate (about 550 offices, 14,500 endpoints, acquired firms)
existing_controls: EDR; immutable backups; offline copies; annual tier-1 DR tests; 24x7 SOC
treatment_plan: Close the Disbursement Hub RTO gap (POAM-011); ransomware tabletop each year
key_risk_indicator: EDR coverage; tier-1 DR test results

threat_event: The Disbursement Hub takes longer than its 2-hour process RTO to recover in a real outage
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Bank connector certificates and allow lists were re-registered by hand; recovery took 6.5 hours in the DR test
existing_controls: Warm standby; bank portal fallback for about 150 urgent wires a day
treatment_plan: Automate connector recovery; retest (POAM-011)

threat_event: A Closing Communications Hub outage pushes parties back to email and phone for wire instructions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Fallback relies on staff discipline
existing_controls: Warm standby met its RTO in the 2026 DR test; phone-only procedure with a second closer
treatment_plan: Annual drill of the phone-only procedure

threat_event: An identity platform outage blocks all workforce and agent sign-in
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single identity platform for 52,000 identities
existing_controls: Secondary region; break-glass accounts; recovered in 0.8 hours in the DR test
treatment_plan: Keep annual break-glass test
owner: Director of Identity and Access Management

threat_event: Denial of service on the Hub or the consumer website
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Internet-facing services
existing_controls: Provider DDoS protection; WAF rate limits; static listing site
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low

threat_event: A hurricane closes Florida offices and threatens colocation DC-1
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Florida headquarters; DC-1 in Florida
existing_controls: Generators; weekly offline copy to DC-2; cloud-hosted network hubs
treatment_plan: Shift legacy file servers off DC-1 with POAM-013; hurricane playbook drill each June
owner: Vice President, Corporate Real Estate and Facilities

threat_event: A carrier outage takes down a sales office without cellular failover
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 120 sales offices lack cellular failover
existing_controls: Two carriers per site; agents can work from mobile devices
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low

threat_event: Attackers destroy backups along with production
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Backups are a known ransomware target
existing_controls: Write-once retention; separate backup accounts and credentials; weekly offline copy
treatment_plan: Quarterly restore tests of tier-1 data

threat_event: An unpatched internet-facing component is exploited
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 5 of 60 sampled internet-facing critical or high findings missed the SLA
existing_controls: Continuous scanning; 15-day SLA for critical internet-facing findings
treatment_plan: SLA escalation to the CIO; weekly exception review (POAM-016)

threat_event: A transaction management platform outage longer than 24 hours stops brokerage transactions in all 9 states
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One platform carries 100% of brokerage transactions; contract RTO 24 hours against an 8-hour BIA RTO; no tested fallback
existing_controls: Vendor SOC 2 report; daily export of open transactions
treatment_plan: Contract amendment for an 8-hour RTO; tested company fallback with daily exports (POAM-007)

threat_event: A title production platform outage or compromise stops about 91% of closings
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One platform carries most closings
existing_controls: Contract RTO 4 hours; observed vendor failover test; read-only nightly export; manual settlement statements
treatment_plan: Annual joint recovery exercise with the vendor

threat_event: A critical vendor's security weakens without detection because its review is overdue (e-signature service; tenant screening provider)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2 of 11 TMCC services and the tenant screening provider lack a current review; the e-signature contract predates standard terms
existing_controls: Tiered third-party program with annual reviews
treatment_plan: Complete overdue reviews; contract amendment (POAM-012)

threat_event: A vendor that holds customer information suffers a breach
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 230 vendors hold customer information or other personal data
existing_controls: Contract breach notice terms; tiered reviews
treatment_plan: Continuous external monitoring of tier-1 and tier-2 vendors

threat_event: An outage at the bank account ownership verification provider forces manual callbacks for all disbursements
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One provider verifies 86% of disbursements
existing_controls: Manual callback procedure; a 3-hour outage in 2026-02 was handled manually
treatment_plan: Evaluate a second provider in 2027

threat_event: Malicious code arrives in a trusted vendor update or SaaS integration
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Many SaaS integrations with broad API scopes
existing_controls: Least-privilege API scopes; egress allow lists
treatment_plan: API scope review for every tier-1 integration

threat_event: The managed security service provider's overflow access is misused
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MSSP analysts see alerts and limited case data
existing_controls: Read-only role; PAM; contract terms; SOC 2 Type 2 report
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low

threat_event: The payoff aggregation service is compromised and returns altered payee details
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 60% of payoffs come through one service
existing_controls: Payee verification on payoff accounts; amount checks
treatment_plan: Verify payoff payees against the verification provider even when the payoff service supplies them

threat_event: AQ-09's legacy closing software fails and up to a day of closing data is lost
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Nightly backup only; real RPO 24 hours against 15 minutes
existing_controls: Urgent closings handed to enterprise Texas offices
treatment_plan: Migration into SYS-02 (POAM-005)

threat_event: A future acquisition brings unassessed systems onto the enterprise network before due diligence
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Nine acquisitions in 2024-2026; integration funding set after closing
existing_controls: Security due diligence checklist since 2025
treatment_plan: Security sign-off and integration budget required in deal approval
key_risk_indicator: Acquired firms not integrated after 12 months

threat_event: Escrow ledgers and agent payments at AQ-06 to AQ-08 run outside enterprise controls
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Own escrow ledgers and commission systems until migration
existing_controls: Monthly reconciliation reviewed by the broker of record
treatment_plan: Migrate ledgers and commission payments with the tenant migration (POAM-004)

threat_event: Material BEC losses, or a series of related incidents, are disclosed late or inaccurately because the materiality playbook covers ransomware only
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No fraud-loss scenario; no method for aggregating related incidents; the disclosure committee has not exercised a BEC case
existing_controls: Disclosure committee charter; ransomware tabletop in 2025; outside securities counsel on retainer
treatment_plan: Add fraud-loss and related-incident criteria; tabletop on 2026-11-17 (POAM-008)
key_risk_indicator: Days from incident to materiality decision in exercises

threat_event: Insiders trade on nonpublic incident information before disclosure
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Incident details spread during a large response
existing_controls: Special blackout procedure triggered by the General Counsel
treatment_plan: Add the blackout step to the BEC runbook (P08)

threat_event: The annual Item 106 disclosure describes processes that do not operate as described
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Disclosure drafted by legal from program documents
existing_controls: CISO and Internal Audit review of the draft
treatment_plan: Internal Audit test of the Item 106 statements before filing

threat_event: An FTC notification event is reported late because discovery at a closing office is not escalated
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Discovery is the first day any employee knows (314.4(j)(2)); closing offices handle fraud reports locally first
existing_controls: Funds response desk; SOC intake
treatment_plan: Discovery date recorded at first report in the case system (POAM-018)
key_risk_indicator: Days from first report to SOC case

threat_event: Breach notice deadlines are missed in a large multi-state incident
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Customers live in all 50 states with different deadlines
existing_controls: Outside counsel and notification vendor on retainer; state law matrix
treatment_plan: Annual refresh of the state deadline matrix

threat_event: A system outage or fraud causes a late earnest money deposit, breaching a state escrow rule
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Deposit deadlines run in business days
existing_controls: Branch deposit and remote deposit fallback; monthly reconciliation
treatment_plan: Deposit deadline report in each state
owner: Florida Broker of Record (with each state's broker of record)

threat_event: The California cybersecurity audit (first report due 2028-04-01) and required risk assessments are not ready
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: New CPPA regulations; audit period starts 2027-01-01
existing_controls: Internal Audit independence structure; existing assessment program
treatment_plan: Readiness plan and risk assessments for AI-001 and AI-002 (POAM-020)

threat_event: The FinCEN residential real estate rule is restored on appeal and Title and Escrow is not ready to report
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Rule vacated 2026-03-19; appeal pending
existing_controls: Legal monitors the appeal
treatment_plan: Accepted while the vacatur stands; procedure to be written within 30 days of any reinstatement

threat_event: A SOX IT general control deficiency in ERP or commission platform access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Frequent role changes
existing_controls: Quarterly access reviews; SOX testing
treatment_plan: Automate commission platform role reviews

threat_event: Relay phishing kits defeat contractor agents' push MFA
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 38,000 agents on authenticator push with number matching
existing_controls: Number matching; risk-based session revocation
treatment_plan: Device-bound passkeys for agents (POAM-001)
owner: Director of Identity and Access Management

threat_event: Agents keep sending wire or deposit instructions by email despite the policy
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Training completion for agents is 71%
existing_controls: Policy POL-04 4.9; data loss prevention rules
treatment_plan: Training tied to transaction platform access (POAM-015)

threat_event: An attacker using a compromised agent account changes the agent's commission payout bank account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Agents can request payout changes from their own account
existing_controls: Second approver and callback for payout changes
treatment_plan: Hold first payout after a change for 2 business days

threat_event: An agent uses client data for an unapproved purpose or takes client lists to a competitor
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Agents control their own contacts and devices
existing_controls: Agent agreement terms; CRM export limits
treatment_plan: CRM export alerts

threat_event: Agents share logins or delegate mailbox access to unlicensed assistants
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Team-based agents use assistants
existing_controls: Assistant accounts available on request
treatment_plan: Assistant role in SYS-01; detection of concurrent sign-ins

threat_event: Automated tenant screening denies applicants in a protected class at higher rates
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Bias tested only on vendor data; criminal history and eviction inputs
existing_controls: Written screening criteria; individualized review on request
treatment_plan: Local disparate outcome testing and input review (POAM-019)
key_risk_indicator: Denial rate ratios by group (proxy method)

threat_event: Tenant screening ADMT is used in California and Colorado after 2027-01-01 without the required notices, appeal, and records
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No pre-use notice, appeal path, or adverse outcome explanation yet
existing_controls: Written criteria; FCRA adverse action notices
treatment_plan: Notices, human appeal, and record keeping before 2027-01-01 (POAM-021)

threat_event: Buyer lead scoring under-serves leads from some neighborhoods or groups
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Score uses behavior and location signals
existing_controls: Score affects follow-up order only; every lead is routed
treatment_plan: Outcome monitoring by area (P10)

threat_event: AI use cases run without governance committee review
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 5 of 12 use cases lack committee review
existing_controls: Committee formed 2025; inventory
treatment_plan: Complete reviews (POAM-019)

threat_event: A generative AI listing description or chatbot makes discriminatory or false statements
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Generated text published at scale
existing_controls: Agent review before publishing; blocked-term filters
treatment_plan: Quarterly sample review of published text

threat_event: The buyer pre-qualification assistant gives wrong financing information or collects data beyond its notice
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Assistant answers financing questions
existing_controls: Assistant limited to general information; financing questions routed to licensed lenders
treatment_plan: Notice at collection review

threat_event: A deepfake voice call impersonates an escrow officer or seller to authorize a change
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Callbacks rely on voice recognition
existing_controls: Callbacks to independent numbers; changes need a verification result
treatment_plan: Add deepfake scenarios to closer training
